title: The signal loop
summary: An editorial chapter hung from the Index Spine under B's shared head ('Three layers.' + light 'One closed loop.'). The direction's one diagram is an orthogonal hairline loop on the grid (Narrative → Channels → Intelligence) that hangs from the spine by its input wire; a single red return, drawn as the mark's right angle, closes it, and a dashed reroute runs back up into Channels. Beside it, a ledger of the loop's four moves (Define, Activate, Measure, Retune) with Retune open, lighting its segment on hover.

reference.borrowed: FREITAG's thin-ruled sheet split in two: a closed cycle of numbered stations with mono-caps labels at the corners ('1. RESOURCES … 4. COMPOST') joined clockwise by arrows, next to a small mono label over a calm reading column that explains how the cycle closes.
reference.kelwin: The circle becomes an orthogonal 1px rectangle on the 12-column grid (cols 5–8). Each station has a 6px joint square that echoes the spine joint, and a 48px light wide index numeral (01–03) sits inside its corner in the spine's own typographic voice. FREITAG's mono station names stay outside the corners, and its drawn illustrations become one Mona line per station from the source copy. The chunky arrows become 5px hairline chevrons. The fourth corner is no station: it is where the red return turns, so the only --accent line (Intelligence → back into Narrative) is literally the mark's right angle. The source's second feedback (Intelligence → Channels, 'reroute effort') runs as a dashed hairline parallel to the forward line. The input wire leaves the spine so the loop hangs from it, and the output wire runs to the right margin as COMPOUNDING PIPELINE. FREITAG's reading column becomes a B ledger of the loop's four moves (N·01–N·04, Mona 24px titles, + / − toggles) with exactly one row open, plus the ownership line and the quiet secondary door under the output wire. Nothing is filled or boxed: just hairlines, type and the spine.

motion: entrance: the opening rule draws from the spine to the right margin (900ms) and its joint square appears. The 05 index and red-square label fade in (400ms). 'Three layers.' rises 12px (700ms) with the light 'One closed loop.' 160ms behind, the 48×2 red rule draws and the lede rises. The ledger rows reveal top-down as rules drawing, at a 60ms stagger.

the one orchestrated moment: the input wire leaves the spine (450ms), then the loop plots 1 → 2 → 3 (top side, then right side, --ease-out), with each station label and chevron fading in as the line reaches it. The output wire runs out to the margin. The red return then draws as one right angle from Intelligence along the bottom and up into Narrative (900ms --ease-inout, about 2.95–3.85s). As it lands, the dashed reroute settles in (600ms) and ledger row N·04 Retune opens in place (height and opacity, 360ms; + rotates to −).

interaction: the ledger really opens, one row at a time. Hovering a row fills it with --panel, shifts its title 8px right and lights its segment of the loop and its station numeral (row N·04 thickens the red return and lifts the dashed reroute). The secondary link underlines from the left (300ms).
on the live site: the spine index is sticky and crossfades as sections pass, and the loop plots once when the diagram enters view. Reduced motion shows the fully drawn loop with N·04 open.
notes: Coherence pass: the 56px head with a mono spine name was brought to the shared head; the statement is the source's own two lines ('Three layers. / One closed loop.') and the source sub-copy becomes the lede. Diagram numerals 01–03 drop tabular figures; diagram labels are 11px mono at .18em; 'See how we install it' is a tracked-caps quiet door. Coherence pass (direction B, one site): every section now shares one head — 64px light index + red-square caps label (Mona 500, 11px, .18em) in the spine column, 88px statement at weight 430 / −0.018em with exactly one light (300) muted sentence, the 48×2 red rule, 18/30 lede — at 48/44/32px offsets from a 6px joint, with 128px top and bottom padding (the live site keeps B's 200px). Mono captions are 11px at .18em; spine numerals drop tabular figures (Mona's tabular zero is slashed); quiet doors are 12px tracked caps with a drawn arrow. The loop sits on column edges (x 509 = col 5, x 931 = col 8's right edge), so col 9 stays empty between drawing and ledger. All station descriptors are source copy.
